enemy_scope_consistency.rule: All matched references were read from WCL's default Nefarian's End damage-done view. Only farY2cm8JMTB1jGh recorded that this view excludes Animated Bone Warriors (41918); for the other two the exclusion is inferred (same view; WCL filters per encounter; raid DPS x duration within 0.031% of combined boss health in all three kills, per the round-1 review).
enemy_scope_consistency.native_side: The raid target lists 41918 in native_dps_excluded_target_entries, so the scoreboard computes each bot's encounter_window_dps (and party DPS) without bone-warrior damage, from the analyzer's damage_by_target_entry. A run analysed without that breakdown fails closed.
enemy_scope_consistency.why_not_rederive: The raw captures (~/.cache/nef_wcl3-5, DVC archive wcl_raw_captures_bwd10n_20260927) hold only default-filtered damage-done totals, with no per-target split, so bone-warrior-inclusive DPS cannot be re-derived without a new WCL read.
